name: children-forwarding
body:
`children` is a layout constructor that forwards a caller's authored `.data.<section>` entries as child sections of a `section` helper call: `(children "<section>" .data.<section>)`. Its first argument is the declared section name — the name of a slot in the helper target's declared `sections:` — exactly as an authored `# <section>` heading names a section (child-constructor); its second is the caller's `.data` list for a declared section. Each entry in that list is re-instantiated as a child of the helper target under the named section, keeping its own template: the entry's template is its `.item.template` — the `template:` selection the entry carries as an authored instance (section-frontmatter, item-context) — so the entries of one forwarded list may name different templates and no single template is imposed on the list; the entry's fields are its `.raw` source field values, its body is its `.raw.body`, and its own children are the entry's own `.data`, so a layout passes on the authored section instances it received without re-listing them. The forwarded children resolve exactly as literal `child` arguments do: the target's declared `sections:` declare the named section and accept each entry's template (a template the named declaration does not accept is a render-time error naming the declaration), the declaration's min/max are counted over the forwarded set, each entry's fields and body validate against its own template (field-rules, body-rules), each child's own sub-children come from the entry's `.data`, and each child gets its own `.item` descriptor with `section` the named declared section and `template` the entry's authored template (child-constructor, section-data-context). A `children` value is consumed only as a child argument of a `section` call; because a `.data` list is a runtime value, a `children` call is not inspected at load and is checked against the target's declared sections when the target renders (section-helper-load-checks). `children` reads only the `.data` list passed to it and adds no data access of its own.

AC: `{{ section "columns" nil nil (children "column" .data.columns) }}` re-instantiates the caller's authored `columns` entries as children of the target's declared `column` section, each keeping its own source template selection, its `.raw` field values and its `.raw.body`; a forwarded list whose entries carry different templates gives each child its own template; an entry with its own children forwards them; a forwarded set that leaves a declared section below its min is a render-time error naming the declaration; a `children` value passed where a `section` call expects its `fields` map or its `body` string is a render-time templates error naming the layout file:line.
